name: Reaper Spectre Strength boosts Strength and Armor Penetration natively
contract: Spectre Strength rank 1 (804671) and rank 2 (807886) promise 'Increases your Strength and Armor
Their DBC effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE (137) with EffectMiscValue 0 (STAT_STRENGTH),
and effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT (280). Both are generic native unit-stat auras applied
by Unit::UpdateStatBuffMod and the armor-penetration calculation whenever the aura is present, requiring no
CoA-specific handler. The harness exposes no metric for the armor-penetration percentage itself, so this
scenario only asserts the Strength half of the tooltip.

steps.label: Rank 1 raises Strength above the untalented base
Strength returns to the untalented base
Rank 2 raises Strength above the untalented base
